description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterCacheResource, which implements a method to unregister cache resources in the Smarty templating engine. The class contains a property and a method that interacts with Smarty's internal cache resource registry.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterCacheResource
classes.description: Implements the unregisterCacheResource method to remove a cache resource identified by name from Smarty's registry.

methods.name: unregisterCacheResource
methods.description: Unregisters a cache resource from Smarty based on the resource name.
